description:
RequestRemoteModel is used to request remote access.
web browser -> signaling server -> desk server

credential.description: Credential for the ICE server, if any.

urls.description: List of URLs associated with the ICE server, e.g. ["stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"]

username.description: Username for the ICE server, if any.

ice_servers.description: ICE servers, the value comes from signaling server
